violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: non NSF bread slicer observed with accumulation of debris.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: non NSF bread slicer observed with accumulation of debris, PIC stated they cannot take the machine apart to clean.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. EHS recommends obtaining a new bread slicer which can be taken apart to clean.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink at kitchen entry.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Paper towels provided by employee.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sausage patty (45F) and sliced cheese (45F) observed in walk in cooler. PIC stated foods are warm from constant use of cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS recommended utilizing ice to cool food items.

violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC UNDERSTANDS TO THROUGHLY CLEAN FOOD EQUIPMENT AFTER USE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer milk gallon jug was observed reused for the storage of beef broth.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC UNDERSTANDS MANUFACTURER GALLON JUGS CANNOT BE REUSED. PIC WILL REPLACE THE GALLON JUG WITH A DURABLE, WASHABLE CONTAINER.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: equipment and floor surrounding the fryer
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE ENSURE FRYER AREA IS CLEANED TO SIGHT AND TOUCH.
